item: Dates beside text keep their order under Arabic: ooIsoDate sweep and a raw-date ratchet (0.5.1 item 46)
refs: PR #1516; 0.5.1 item 46; R258 R259; follows PR #1498; audit 0.5.0 follow-on
key_paths: src/static/app-core.js src/static/app-home.js src/static/app-analysis.js src/static/app-map.js src/static/app-living.js src/static/app-insights.js src/static/app-claim.js src/static/app-corpus.js src/static/app-shell.js src/static/reader.js tests/oo_iso_date_node_test.js tests/test_raw_date_ratchet.py
summary: #1498 isolated ISO dates in the keyed Home card frames; about 30 other places still put a raw slice(0,10) date next to a source name, a label or a translated sentence, and under Arabic an Arabic letter before the date turns its digits into Arabic numbers (bidi W2) so 2025-12-14 draws as 14-12-2025. ooIsoDate(s, n) and ooIsoDateTime(s) in app-core.js wrap the date in a first-strong isolate U+2068..2069 only under dir=rtl (left-to-right is byte-identical; an empty value stays empty), and the render sites were swapped one token each in app-home (6), app-analysis (11), app-map (5), app-living (3), app-insights (2), app-claim, app-corpus, app-shell, with a local isolate in reader.js. A date alone in its own cell and every computation, id, hash, filename and chart axis is unchanged. tests/test_raw_date_ratchet.py pins each file's count of slice(0,10|16) with zero slack, so a new raw date slice reddens by file name. Probed in Chromium under dir=rtl with the real helper and real ar.json frames, per group: raw reordered, helper in order (qual-lane/item46-probe). Inferred, not clicked through: that each call site has Arabic text right before its date, which depends on data such as an Arabic source name.
